title: Transfer a vehicle registration
summary: Find out how to transfer the ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle to update Transport for NSW records.
intro: When a NSW-registered vehicle changes ownership, Transport for NSW needs to update its records. To do this, it requires:
who_can_apply: You are transferring the ownership of a vehicle registered in NSW.
The previous owner/seller submitted a Notice of Disposal (NOD).
You bought the vehicle due to the death of the owner.
You are transferring the registration as the carer or guardian of the vehicle’s owner.
The vehicle is a heavy vehicle with a gross vehicle mass of over 4.5 tonnes.
The vehicle has special or personalised number plates that you do not want to keep.
The vehicle’s previous NSW registration expired more than 3 months ago.
You are entitled to a stamp duty exemption.
what_you_need: The purchase date of the vehicle.
The purchase price or market price of the vehicle (whichever is higher).
Payment for the completed PDF form – 'Application for Transfer of Registration'.
The vehicle's certificate of registration, completed and signed on the back by the seller, or other proof of registration entitlement.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to transfer the registration.

more_info.text: When you buy a vehicle that has a current NSW registration, the compulsory third party (CTP) insurance (green slip) will automatically transfer to you.
If you are transferring a current NSW registration, you will not need a safety inspection report (pink slip).
If special or personalised number plates have been transferred with the vehicle, you take on all the rights, responsibilities and annual fees that go with those plates.
Contact your provider to update your vehicle details if you have an e-toll or toll pass account. You can open an account if you do not already have one.
Read the guide for more about how to Transfer ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle. The guide includes information for a vehicle:

faqs.q: Who needs to transfer the vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You must transfer the registration when a NSW-registered vehicle changes ownership.

faqs.q: What do I need to transfer the registration online?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your concession details (if applicable), the purchase date, the purchase price or market price of the vehicle (whichever is higher), proof of identity, and your payment.

faqs.q: What is required if the previous owner did not submit a Notice of Disposal?
faqs.a: The content does not specify what to do if the previous owner has not submitted a Notice of Disposal.
